CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_internal_commercial_actor()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND public.h15_actor_organization() IS NOT NULL AND platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(auth.uid()) AND (public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador'::public.app_role) OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles r WHERE r.user_id=auth.uid() AND r.role IN ('parceiro_b2b','parceiro_b2b_tecnico')); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_metadata_require_actor()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_actor uuid:=auth.uid(); v_jwt jsonb:=auth.jwt();
BEGIN
  IF v_actor IS NULL OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(v_jwt->'iat') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
    OR COALESCE(v_jwt->>'iat','') !~ '^[0-9]{1,12}$'
    OR pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(v_jwt->'exp') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
    OR COALESCE(v_jwt->>'exp','') !~ '^[0-9]{1,12}$' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501', MESSAGE='catalog_metadata_forbidden';
  END IF;
  IF (v_jwt->>'iat')::bigint <= 0 OR (v_jwt->>'exp')::bigint <= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM pg_catalog.statement_timestamp())
    OR (v_jwt->>'iat')::bigint > EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM pg_catalog.statement_timestamp())
    OR NOT COALESCE(public.has_role(v_actor,'superadmin'::public.app_role),false)
    OR NOT COALESCE(public.is_platform_superadmin(v_actor),false)
    OR NOT COALESCE(platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(v_actor),false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501', MESSAGE='catalog_metadata_forbidden';
  END IF;
  RETURN v_actor;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_entity_audit(p_actor uuid, p_operation text, p_reason text, p_key uuid, p_request jsonb, p_receipt jsonb, p_before jsonb, p_after jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  INSERT INTO public.catalog_platform_admin_audit (id,operation,actor_id,reason,correlation_id,status,counts_before,counts_after,completed_at)
  VALUES ((p_receipt->>'audit_id')::uuid,p_operation,p_actor,pg_catalog.btrim(p_reason),p_key,'completed',COALESCE(p_before,'{}'::jsonb),
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('request',p_request,'receipt',p_receipt,'after',p_after),pg_catalog.clock_timestamp());
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.producer_commercial_client_scope(p_client uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND p_client IS NOT NULL
 AND platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(auth.uid()) IS TRUE
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=p.organization_id
 JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=p_client AND c.organization_id=p.organization_id
 WHERE p.user_id=auth.uid() AND p.ativo IS TRUE AND p.senha_provisoria IS FALSE
 AND o.ativo IS TRUE AND c.status_cliente='ativo'
 AND (public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador'::public.app_role)
 OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'gestor'::public.app_role)
 OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'cliente_produtor'::public.app_role))
 AND p_client=ANY(public.get_cliente_ids_for_user(auth.uid())));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_conformidade_perfil_vigente(p_produto_id uuid, p_categoria text)
 RETURNS produto_conformidade_perfis
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT *
  FROM public.produto_conformidade_perfis p
  WHERE p.status = 'aprovado'
    AND (p.vigencia_inicio IS NULL OR p.vigencia_inicio <= CURRENT_DATE)
    AND (p.vigencia_fim IS NULL OR p.vigencia_fim >= CURRENT_DATE)
    AND (
      (p_produto_id IS NOT NULL AND p.produto_id = p_produto_id)
      OR (p.produto_id IS NULL AND p_categoria IS NOT NULL AND p.categoria = p_categoria)
    )
  ORDER BY (p.produto_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, p.versao DESC
  LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fiscal_company_crt()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT (
      auth.uid() IS NULL
      OR public.fn_fiscal_can_read_internal(auth.uid())
      OR public.can_view_catalog_internal(auth.uid())
    ) THEN NULL::text ELSE (
    SELECT nullif(btrim(coalesce(c.crt,'')),'')
      FROM (SELECT * FROM public.company_fiscal_settings WHERE organization_id = public.h15_actor_organization()) c
     WHERE c.is_active = true
     ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST
     LIMIT 1
  ) END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fiscal_digits(_v text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT regexp_replace(coalesce(_v,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fiscal_resolve_operation(_direction text, _origin_uf text, _destination_uf text, _crt text, _final_consumer boolean, _taxpayer_indicator text, _ncm text, _product_category text, _sales_channel text, _ref_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS fiscal_operation_policies
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE p public.fiscal_operation_policies%ROWTYPE; n_tie int;
BEGIN
  WITH cand AS (
    SELECT f.*,
           row_number() OVER (ORDER BY f.priority ASC,
             (f.ncm_prefix IS NOT NULL) DESC, (f.destination_uf IS NOT NULL) DESC,
             (f.origin_uf IS NOT NULL) DESC, (f.taxpayer_indicator IS NOT NULL) DESC,
             (f.final_consumer IS NOT NULL) DESC, f.valid_from DESC) AS rn,
           f.priority AS p_ord,
           (f.ncm_prefix IS NOT NULL) AS s_ncm,
           (f.destination_uf IS NOT NULL) AS s_dest,
           (f.origin_uf IS NOT NULL) AS s_orig,
           (f.taxpayer_indicator IS NOT NULL) AS s_ind,
           (f.final_consumer IS NOT NULL) AS s_fc
      FROM public.fiscal_operation_policies f
     WHERE f.policy_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND f.document_model = '55' AND f.active IS TRUE
       AND f.direction = _direction
       AND (f.origin_uf IS NULL OR f.origin_uf = upper(_origin_uf))
       AND (f.destination_uf IS NULL OR f.destination_uf = upper(_destination_uf))
       AND (f.crt IS NULL OR f.crt = _crt)
       AND (f.final_consumer IS NULL OR f.final_consumer = _final_consumer)
       AND (f.taxpayer_indicator IS NULL OR f.taxpayer_indicator = _taxpayer_indicator)
       AND (f.ncm_prefix IS NULL OR public.fn_fiscal_digits(_ncm) LIKE f.ncm_prefix || '%')
       AND (f.product_category IS NULL OR f.product_category = _product_category)
       AND (f.sales_channel IS NULL OR f.sales_channel = _sales_channel)
       AND f.valid_from <= _ref_date
       AND (f.valid_until IS NULL OR f.valid_until >= _ref_date)
  )
  SELECT count(*) INTO n_tie
    FROM cand
   WHERE (p_ord, s_ncm, s_dest, s_orig, s_ind, s_fc, valid_from)
       = (SELECT p_ord, s_ncm, s_dest, s_orig, s_ind, s_fc, valid_from FROM cand WHERE rn = 1);

  IF n_tie IS NULL OR n_tie = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_OPERATION_POLICY_NOT_FOUND: sem politica publicada para direcao=% origem=% destino=% crt=% consumidorFinal=% indIEDest=% ncm=%',
      _direction, _origin_uf, _destination_uf, _crt, _final_consumer, _taxpayer_indicator, coalesce(_ncm,'-')
      USING HINT = 'Cadastre e publique a politica de operacao com CFOP, natureza, base legal e fonte oficial.';
  END IF;
  IF n_tie > 1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_OPERATION_POLICY_AMBIGUOUS: % politicas publicadas com a mesma precedencia efetiva (origem=%, destino=%).',
      n_tie, _origin_uf, _destination_uf
      USING HINT = 'Resolva a ambiguidade por priority/vigencia/especificidade antes de emitir.';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO p FROM public.fiscal_operation_policies f
   WHERE f.policy_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND f.document_model = '55' AND f.active IS TRUE
     AND f.direction = _direction
     AND (f.origin_uf IS NULL OR f.origin_uf = upper(_origin_uf))
     AND (f.destination_uf IS NULL OR f.destination_uf = upper(_destination_uf))
     AND (f.crt IS NULL OR f.crt = _crt)
     AND (f.final_consumer IS NULL OR f.final_consumer = _final_consumer)
     AND (f.taxpayer_indicator IS NULL OR f.taxpayer_indicator = _taxpayer_indicator)
     AND (f.ncm_prefix IS NULL OR public.fn_fiscal_digits(_ncm) LIKE f.ncm_prefix || '%')
     AND (f.product_category IS NULL OR f.product_category = _product_category)
     AND (f.sales_channel IS NULL OR f.sales_channel = _sales_channel)
     AND f.valid_from <= _ref_date
     AND (f.valid_until IS NULL OR f.valid_until >= _ref_date)
   ORDER BY f.priority ASC, (f.ncm_prefix IS NOT NULL) DESC,
            (f.destination_uf IS NOT NULL) DESC, (f.origin_uf IS NOT NULL) DESC,
            (f.taxpayer_indicator IS NOT NULL) DESC, (f.final_consumer IS NOT NULL) DESC,
            f.valid_from DESC
   LIMIT 1;
  RETURN p;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fiscal_resolve_tax_rule(_tax_kind text, _crt text, _origin_uf text, _destination_uf text, _ncm text, _product_category text, _final_consumer boolean, _taxpayer_indicator text, _ref_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS fiscal_tax_rules
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE r public.fiscal_tax_rules%ROWTYPE; n_tie int;
BEGIN
  IF _tax_kind IN ('IBS','CBS','IS') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_RTC_ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE: tributo % nao possui engine compativel nesta fase.', _tax_kind;
  END IF;

  WITH cand AS (
    SELECT t.*,
           row_number() OVER (ORDER BY t.priority ASC,
             (t.ncm_prefix IS NOT NULL) DESC, (t.destination_uf IS NOT NULL) DESC,
             (t.origin_uf IS NOT NULL) DESC, t.valid_from DESC, t.version DESC) AS rn,
           t.priority AS p_ord,
           (t.ncm_prefix IS NOT NULL) AS s_ncm,
           (t.destination_uf IS NOT NULL) AS s_dest,
           (t.origin_uf IS NOT NULL) AS s_orig
      FROM public.fiscal_tax_rules t
     WHERE t.status = 'PUBLISHED'
       AND t.tax_kind = _tax_kind
       AND (t.crt IS NULL OR t.crt = _crt)
       AND (t.origin_uf IS NULL OR t.origin_uf = upper(_origin_uf))
       AND (t.destination_uf IS NULL OR t.destination_uf = upper(_destination_uf))
       AND (t.ncm_prefix IS NULL OR public.fn_fiscal_digits(_ncm) LIKE t.ncm_prefix || '%')
       AND (t.product_category IS NULL OR t.product_category = _product_category)
       AND (t.final_consumer IS NULL OR t.final_consumer = _final_consumer)
       AND (t.taxpayer_indicator IS NULL OR t.taxpayer_indicator = _taxpayer_indicator)
       AND t.valid_from <= _ref_date
       AND (t.valid_until IS NULL OR t.valid_until >= _ref_date)
  )
  SELECT count(*) INTO n_tie
    FROM cand
   WHERE (p_ord, s_ncm, s_dest, s_orig, valid_from)
       = (SELECT p_ord, s_ncm, s_dest, s_orig, valid_from FROM cand WHERE rn = 1);

  IF n_tie IS NULL OR n_tie = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_TAX_RULE_NOT_FOUND: sem regra publicada para tributo=% crt=% origem=% destino=% ncm=%',
      _tax_kind, _crt, _origin_uf, _destination_uf, coalesce(_ncm,'-')
      USING HINT = 'Cadastre a regra com CST/CSOSN, parametros do tributo, base legal e fonte oficial, e publique-a. Ausencia de regra nunca e isencao.';
  END IF;
  IF n_tie > 1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_TAX_RULE_AMBIGUOUS: % regras publicadas com a mesma precedencia efetiva para tributo=% origem=% destino=%.',
      n_tie, _tax_kind, _origin_uf, _destination_uf
      USING HINT = 'Ajuste priority/vigencia/especificidade. O motor nunca escolhe silenciosamente.';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO r FROM public.fiscal_tax_rules t
   WHERE t.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND t.tax_kind = _tax_kind
     AND (t.crt IS NULL OR t.crt = _crt)
     AND (t.origin_uf IS NULL OR t.origin_uf = upper(_origin_uf))
     AND (t.destination_uf IS NULL OR t.destination_uf = upper(_destination_uf))
     AND (t.ncm_prefix IS NULL OR public.fn_fiscal_digits(_ncm) LIKE t.ncm_prefix || '%')
     AND (t.product_category IS NULL OR t.product_category = _product_category)
     AND (t.final_consumer IS NULL OR t.final_consumer = _final_consumer)
     AND (t.taxpayer_indicator IS NULL OR t.taxpayer_indicator = _taxpayer_indicator)
     AND t.valid_from <= _ref_date
     AND (t.valid_until IS NULL OR t.valid_until >= _ref_date)
   ORDER BY t.priority ASC, (t.ncm_prefix IS NOT NULL) DESC,
            (t.destination_uf IS NOT NULL) DESC, (t.origin_uf IS NOT NULL) DESC,
            t.valid_from DESC, t.version DESC
   LIMIT 1;

  -- Coerencia CRT em tempo de resolucao (defesa adicional a constraint).
  IF r.tax_kind IN ('ICMS','ICMS_ST') AND _crt IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF _crt IN ('1','2') AND r.csosn IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_CRT_INCOHERENT: emitente CRT % exige CSOSN na regra de %.', _crt, r.tax_kind;
    END IF;
    IF _crt IN ('3','4') AND r.cst IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_CRT_INCOHERENT: emitente CRT % exige CST de ICMS na regra de %.', _crt, r.tax_kind;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN r;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_microorganism_regulatory_facts(p_microorganism_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH g AS (
    SELECT (auth.uid() IS NULL
            OR public.fn_regulatory_can_read(auth.uid())
            OR public.fn_fiscal_can_read_internal(auth.uid())
            OR public.can_view_catalog_internal(auth.uid())) AS ok
  ), d AS (
    SELECT * FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_dossiers
     WHERE microorganism_id = p_microorganism_id AND deleted_at IS NULL
       AND (SELECT ok FROM g)
     ORDER BY (status='VALIDATED') DESC, version DESC
     LIMIT 1)
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT (SELECT ok FROM g) THEN NULL
              WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM d) THEN NULL ELSE (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'dossier_id', d.id,
      'version', d.version,
      'status', d.status,
      'blocked_reason', d.blocked_reason,
      'regulatory_category', d.regulatory_category,
      'strain', coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.strain_code,'')),''), nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.strain_name,'')),'')),
      'formulation', nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.formulation,'')),''),
      'label_guarantee', nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.label_guarantee,'')),''),
      'mapa_status', d.mapa_status,
      'mapa_registration_number', nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.mapa_registration_number,'')),''),
      'mapa_holder', nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.mapa_holder,'')),''),
      'mapa_valid_until', d.mapa_valid_until,
      'mapa_not_applicable_reason', nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.mapa_not_applicable_reason,'')),''),
      'published_ncm', d.published_ncm,
      'published_cest', d.published_cest,
      'effective_from', d.effective_from,
      'effective_to', d.effective_to,
      'review_technical', d.technical_review_status,
      'review_regulatory', d.regulatory_review_status,
      'review_fiscal', d.fiscal_review_status,
      'has_label_document', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_documents x
                                     WHERE x.dossier_id=d.id AND x.deleted_at IS NULL AND x.doc_type='ROTULO'),
      'has_report_document', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_documents x
                                     WHERE x.dossier_id=d.id AND x.deleted_at IS NULL AND x.doc_type IN ('LAUDO','CERTIFICADO_ANALISE')),
      'expired_documents', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_documents x
                             WHERE x.dossier_id=d.id AND x.deleted_at IS NULL
                               AND x.valid_until IS NOT NULL AND x.valid_until < current_date),
      'ncm_approved', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.microorganism_ncm_candidates c
                               WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id AND c.status='APPROVED'),
      'ncm_candidates', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_ncm_candidates c WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id),
      'checklist_total', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_checklist c WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id),
      'checklist_pending', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(c.item_key ORDER BY c.item_key)
                                      FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_checklist c
                                      WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id AND c.state='PENDING'),'[]'::jsonb),
      'checklist_not_applicable', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                                      'item_key',c.item_key,'justification',c.justification) ORDER BY c.item_key)
                                      FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_checklist c
                                      WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id AND c.state='NOT_APPLICABLE'),'[]'::jsonb),
      'checklist_confirmed', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_checklist c
                               WHERE c.dossier_id=d.id AND c.state='CONFIRMED'),
      'presentations_total', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_presentations p WHERE p.dossier_id=d.id),
      'presentations_units_unconfirmed', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_presentations p
                                           WHERE p.dossier_id=d.id AND NOT p.units_confirmed),
      'presentations_gtin_unconfirmed', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_presentations p
                                          WHERE p.dossier_id=d.id AND NOT p.gtin_confirmed))
    FROM d) END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_user_access_aplicacao(_aplicacao_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(
    _aplicacao_id IS NOT NULL
    AND auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.aplicacoes a
      LEFT JOIN public.ordens_servico os ON os.id = a.ordem_servico_id
      LEFT JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id = os.cliente_id
      LEFT JOIN public.ordens_servico_onfarm oso ON oso.id = a.ordem_servico_onfarm_id
      LEFT JOIN public.clientes co ON co.id = oso.cliente_id
      WHERE a.id = _aplicacao_id
        AND a.organization_id = public.h15_actor_organization()
        -- Every present parent must exist and remain in the application's tenant.
        AND (a.ordem_servico_id IS NULL OR (
          os.id IS NOT NULL AND os.organization_id = a.organization_id
          AND c.id IS NOT NULL AND c.organization_id = a.organization_id
        ))
        -- On-farm has no organization_id: its persisted client is the tenant origin.
        AND (a.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NULL OR (
          oso.id IS NOT NULL AND co.id IS NOT NULL
          AND co.organization_id = a.organization_id
        ))
        AND (
          public.is_operational_staff(auth.uid())
          OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::app_role)
          OR os.cliente_id = ANY (public.get_cliente_ids_for_user(auth.uid()))
          OR oso.cliente_id = ANY (public.get_cliente_ids_for_user(auth.uid()))
        )
    ), false
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_user_manage_aplicacao(_aplicacao_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT _aplicacao_id IS NOT NULL
     AND auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
     AND (
       public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrativo'::app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'consultor_tecnico'::app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'aplicador'::app_role)
     )
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.aplicacoes a WHERE a.id = _aplicacao_id);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_carteira_kpis(p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrativo'::public.app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT ar.id, ar.issue_date, ari.original_amount, ari.received_amount, ari.due_date, ari.status, ari.paid_at
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    WHERE ar.origin_type='B2B_ORDER'
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'carteira_total', COALESCE(SUM(original_amount),0),
    'carteira_recebida', COALESCE(SUM(received_amount),0),
    'carteira_vencida', COALESCE(SUM(original_amount - received_amount) FILTER (WHERE due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0),
    'carteira_aberto', COALESCE(SUM(original_amount - received_amount) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0),
    'receita_mes', COALESCE(SUM(received_amount) FILTER (WHERE paid_at >= date_trunc('month',now())),0),
    'receita_ano', COALESCE(SUM(received_amount) FILTER (WHERE paid_at >= date_trunc('year',now())),0),
    'inadimplencia_pct', CASE WHEN SUM(original_amount) > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(original_amount - received_amount) FILTER (WHERE due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0)/SUM(original_amount))*100,2) ELSE 0 END,
    'prazo_medio_recebimento', ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (paid_at - issue_date))/86400) FILTER (WHERE paid_at IS NOT NULL),0)::numeric,2),
    'ticket_medio', CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT id) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(original_amount),0)/COUNT(DISTINCT id),2) ELSE 0 END
  ) INTO v
  FROM base
  WHERE (p_from IS NULL OR issue_date >= p_from) AND (p_to IS NULL OR issue_date <= p_to);
  RETURN v;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_revenue_forecast(p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrativo'::public.app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  WITH conf AS (
    SELECT
      SUM(CASE WHEN ari.due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + 30 THEN ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount ELSE 0 END) AS c30,
      SUM(CASE WHEN ari.due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + 60 THEN ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount ELSE 0 END) AS c60,
      SUM(CASE WHEN ari.due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + 90 THEN ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount ELSE 0 END) AS c90
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    WHERE ar.origin_type='B2B_ORDER' AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR ar.partner_id = p_partner_id)
  ),
  proj AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) AS p30
    FROM partner_orders WHERE receivable_generated = false
      AND status IN ('aprovado','em_producao','produzido','aguardando_entrega','em_separacao','enviado','entregue')
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR partner_id = p_partner_id)
  ),
  risk AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount),0) AS r
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    LEFT JOIN partner_risk_scores prs ON prs.partner_id = ar.partner_id
    WHERE ar.origin_type='B2B_ORDER' AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
      AND (ari.due_date < CURRENT_DATE OR COALESCE(prs.risk_level,'baixo')='critico')
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR ar.partner_id = p_partner_id)
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'confirmada_30', COALESCE((SELECT c30 FROM conf),0),
    'confirmada_60', COALESCE((SELECT c60 FROM conf),0),
    'confirmada_90', COALESCE((SELECT c90 FROM conf),0),
    'projetada', COALESCE((SELECT p30 FROM proj),0),
    'em_risco', COALESCE((SELECT r FROM risk),0)
  ) INTO v;
  RETURN v;
END;$function$

    ELSE NULL END;  -- tipo inesperado => NULL SQL => objeto inválido detectado pelo chamador

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fiscal_item_base(_components jsonb, _ctx jsonb)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v numeric := 0; c text;
BEGIN
  IF _components IS NULL OR jsonb_array_length(_components) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_TAX_RULE_INCOMPLETE: regra sem componentes de base declarados (base_components).'
      USING HINT = 'Declare explicitamente PRODUTO/FRETE/SEGURO/OUTRAS_DESPESAS/DESCONTO/IPI/ICMS_ST conforme base legal publicada.';
  END IF;
  FOR c IN SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(_components) LOOP
    v := v + CASE c
      WHEN 'PRODUTO'          THEN coalesce((_ctx->>'produto')::numeric,0)
      WHEN 'FRETE'            THEN coalesce((_ctx->>'frete')::numeric,0)
      WHEN 'SEGURO'           THEN coalesce((_ctx->>'seguro')::numeric,0)
      WHEN 'OUTRAS_DESPESAS'  THEN coalesce((_ctx->>'outras')::numeric,0)
      WHEN 'DESCONTO'         THEN -coalesce((_ctx->>'desconto')::numeric,0)
      WHEN 'IPI'              THEN coalesce((_ctx->>'ipi')::numeric,0)
      WHEN 'ICMS_ST'          THEN coalesce((_ctx->>'icmsSt')::numeric,0)
      ELSE 0 END;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN public.fn_fiscal_round(v);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fiscal_round(_v numeric)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT round(coalesce(_v, 0)::numeric, 2);
$function$

       public.has_role(_uid, 'administrador'::app_role)

    OR public.has_role(_uid, 'administrativo'::app_role)

    OR public.has_role(_uid, 'aplicador'::app_role)
    OR public.has_role(_uid, 'producao'::app_role)
    OR public.has_role(_uid, 'operador_onfarm'::app_role)
  ), false);
$function$

SELECT m.id AS microorganism_id,
    m.codigo,
    m.nome,
    m.ativo,
    sel.id AS profile_id,
    sel.profile_status,
    sel.is_active AS profile_is_active,
    (g.gate ->> 'ready'::text)::boolean AS fiscally_ready,
    (g.gate ->> 'technical_ready'::text)::boolean AS minimally_classified,
    (g.gate ->> 'regulatory_ready'::text)::boolean AS regulatory_ready,
    sel.accounting_validated_at IS NOT NULL AS accounting_validated,
    (g.gate ->> 'quarantined'::text)::boolean AS quarantined,
    reg.facts -> 'dossier_id'::text AS dossier_id,
    reg.facts ->> 'status'::text AS dossier_status,
    g.gate -> 'pendencies'::text AS pendencies,
    g.gate -> 'not_applicable'::text AS not_applicable,
    g.gate
   FROM microrganismos m
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT mfp.id,
            mfp.microorganism_id,
            mfp.is_active,
            mfp.fiscal_description,
            mfp.commercial_unit,
            mfp.taxable_unit,
            mfp.ncm,
            mfp.cest,
            mfp.origin_code,
            mfp.cfop_in_state,
            mfp.cfop_interstate,
            mfp.icms_cst,
            mfp.icms_csosn,
            mfp.pis_cst,
            mfp.cofins_cst,
            mfp.ipi_cst,
            mfp.gtin,
            mfp.taxable_gtin,
            mfp.tax_benefit_code,
            mfp.profile_status,
            mfp.accounting_notes,
            mfp.accounting_validated_at,
            mfp.accounting_validated_by,
            mfp.created_at,
            mfp.updated_at,
            mfp.created_by,
            mfp.updated_by
           FROM microorganism_fiscal_profiles mfp
          WHERE mfp.microorganism_id = m.id
          ORDER BY (mfp.is_active AND mfp.profile_status = 'VALIDATED'::text) DESC, mfp.is_active DESC, mfp.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, mfp.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, mfp.id DESC
         LIMIT 1) sel ON true
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT fn_microorganism_regulatory_facts(m.id) AS facts) reg
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT fn_fiscal_item_profile_gate_eval('MICROORGANISM'::text, fn_fiscal_company_crt(), sel.is_active, sel.profile_status, sel.accounting_validated_at, sel.accounting_notes, sel.fiscal_description, sel.commercial_unit, sel.taxable_unit, sel.ncm, sel.origin_code, sel.cfop_in_state, sel.cfop_interstate, sel.icms_cst, sel.icms_csosn, sel.pis_cst, sel.cofins_cst, reg.facts) AS gate) g;
